summary.text: Spindle 3 temperature peaked at 64.2, which is 4.2 over the 60 °C validated limit (critical alert, open). Three parts in lot TM-HS12-261120-188 are at risk. The rule requires a QA hold, an NCR and CMM inspection.

quarantine.rationale: Their cuts overlapped the time Spindle 3 was above its 60 °C validated limit. The rule requires quarantine of parts machined outside the limit. The other 12 parts of the lot are not listed at risk.

cmm_inspection.scope: CMM-inspect the three at-risk parts for stem taper and neck geometry, the dimensional risk named in the rule. No CMM results exist yet, so the projected right-first-time of 50% is unconfirmed.

ncr.rationale: The rule requires an NCR for parts machined outside the validated limit (PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C). The alert row lists NCR-20261120-154114-55E1 as the id if opened. QA should confirm it exists and is linked to the lot.

maintenance_request.rationale: A validated process parameter was exceeded, and readings stayed above 60 through the last bucket. The last spindle inspection on the same component was 2026-09-01. A check is advised before the spindle runs more product.

risk_narrative.text: The model risk score is 87% (synthetic model, version 3), so the excursion is high risk. The biggest drivers are the 5-minute spindle temperature slope (0.41 contribution) and vibration RMS (0.22). It is advisory and does not replace CMM results.

steps.action: Recommend quarantine of the at-risk parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-188 under the rule's QA hold. A qualified person signs the decision in the app.
Request CMM inspection of the three at-risk parts, focusing on stem taper and neck geometry.
Open or confirm the NCR (id if opened: NCR-20261120-154114-55E1). Reference the 60 °C validated limit, PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C, and the lot DHR.
Inspect Spindle 3 on CNC-1 for the cause of the temperature rise and the vibration signal. Re-verify thermal compensation before restart, as in the 2026-09-01 inspection.
Do not start further parts on Spindle 3 until QA and Maintenance clear it. Acknowledge the open critical alert in the app.
Before releasing the other 12 parts, confirm from the DHR that their cuts did not overlap the excursion. Alert event history was unavailable, so this is not verified.
Assess impact against validated parameters OQ-TM-CNC1-014 and PQ-TM-HS12-022. Decide whether re-qualification is needed once the CMM results are in.
